'''Imperial communications droids''' were utilized by the [[Galactic Federation Triumvirate]] in [[138 ABY]]. [[Unidentified Imperial communications droid|One particular model]] was the companion of junk trader [[Ania Solo]] and [[Imperial Knight]] [[Jao Assam]] during a series of their adventures.
